scheme_name: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana under NSKFDC- Haryana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a woman Safai Karamchari or a dependent daughter of a Safai Karamchari.

Applicant must produce a Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent issued by the Head of Government Departments, elected municipal members, Gram Panchayat Pradhan, Local Revenue Officer, Cantonment Executive Officer, or Railway officer of gazetted rank.
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹2,00,000 with 10% margin money and a 50% subsidy (maximum ₹10,000) for small trade or income‑generating activities.
documents_required: Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent issued by authorized officials
